method: Five independent processes per variant, alternating order. One day180 snapshot generated from the pre-change UtilityAI and current full-establishment maintenance policy; trade/rulers and dynamic diplomacy enabled. Identical order logging/profiling wrappers; before overrides only _decide_ai_army to call archived UtilityAI. Timings exclude snapshot decode, output and invariant audit.
movement_definition: Accepted ATTACK/REINFORCE/RETREAT orders; excludes HOLD and formation creation. Moving samples exclude forced RETREATING state.
limitations: Single seed and 60-day war window, not a 30-year audit or GUI benchmark.
Removing withdrawals changes subsequent attack orders and battle history; this is not an equivalence optimization.
Whole-AI and total-compute differences below 1% are within run variability, not evidence of overall speedup.
